text: Sometimes I think everyone would do better if I just wasn't around.
I had a picture in my head of dropping her down the stairs and I can't stop seeing it.
I don't see the point in waking up anymore.
It feels like there's no way out of this.
Walking to the bathroom leaves me winded and I have to sleep sitting up.
Feels like someone is sitting on my ribs when I try to take a deep breath.
There's a heavy pressure behind my breastbone that goes into my left arm.
My heart keeps going a mile a minute even when I'm resting.
Not a big deal, just this squeeze in my chest when I go up the stairs.
My husband says my whole body was shaking and I wasn't responding for a minute.
I woke up on the bathroom floor and I'm not sure how I got there.
Probably nothing but lol I blacked out for a sec in the shower.
Worst headache of my life came on out of nowhere.
Took ibuprofen twice and drank water but my head still pounds.
Everything went kind of sparkly at the edges for a few minutes.
Reading my phone is hard because there are two of every word.
The thermometer said 101.2 this morning.
My face is so puffy I can barely open my eyes.
I can't make a fist, my fingers look like sausages.
Everything I drink comes right back up, even water.
Stabbing pain low on my right side that's getting worse since last night.
Going through a pad every 45 minutes.
I passed a clot the size of a lemon.
It smells really bad down there, like something is rotting.
My right calf is hot and puffy and it hurts when I walk.
One arm is swollen and aching, the other one is fine.
Even after sleeping six hours I was so wiped I couldn't lift the baby this morning.
I'm pregnant again, 30 weeks, and I haven't felt any kicks today.
I'm pregnant again and there's fluid trickling down my leg.
Baby slept four hours straight and I got a shower today!
Breastfeeding is going better, the latch feels good.
My mother-in-law visited and brought soup.
Tired like every new parent, but I had a good walk.
Cried a little at a commercial, then laughed about it.
My stitches are itchy today.
Some light spotting, less than last week.
My nipples are sore from feeding.
My back aches from carrying the car seat.
My hair is falling out in the shower.
I'm hungry all the time lately.
The baby has a doctor's appointment on Tuesday.
I forgot where I put my keys again.
I feel a bit lonely now that my partner went back to work.
I pumped 3 ounces this morning.
Had a cup of coffee and I feel pretty good.
The baby had a fever last night and her doctor checked her.
My arms are sore from rocking her all night.
A little constipated this week.
I've been sweating a lot at night.
